ui.teamBridge.scope: Full fr ui.teamBridge catalogue (113 keys; 27 added today in focus) read side by side with EN plus the context sidecar, checked against the glossary, the fr style guide and the other fr ui.*/wire.* catalogues; ICU, NFC, bidi and typography checked in the bytes

findings.note: The fr product has already settled on the feminine singular for this role: wire.settings «Cheffe de cabinet activée», wire.slash «votre cheffe de cabinet» and ui.onboarding «{name} est votre cheffe de cabinet» (the EN source uses she/her for the role whatever the name), so a teammate’s nameless chief of staff showing as «Chef de cabinet» is gender drift on the same term. The plural forms (section.chiefs, builtin.agents_topic) correctly keep the generic masculine «chefs de cabinet».

findings.current: Toute l’organisation. Les messages ici notifient chaque personne.
findings.proposed: Toute l’organisation. Les messages envoyés ici notifient chaque personne.
findings.note: «Les messages ici», with no verb, is a calque of “Messages here”; a native writer would add a participle, and the fix costs only one word in a topic line that may truncate.

findings.current: Cette organisation est en lecture seule pour le moment ; les messages ne peuvent pas être envoyés.
findings.proposed: Cette organisation est en lecture seule pour le moment ; les messages ne peuvent pas être envoyés.
findings.note: The space before «;» is U+00A0, but the binding fr style guide requires U+202F (espace fine insécable). This is the only U+00A0-before-«;» in the fr ui.* catalogues, against 95 that use U+202F.
